steps.title: CRISPR-Cas9 RNP editing
steps.text: Seed editing groups, assemble RNP formulations, combine each RNP with lipid delivery mix, and culture edited cells.

steps.title: Isolation of candidate clones
steps.text: Prepare the limiting-dilution suspension, seed the 96-well plate, review colony outgrowth, and pick selected candidate clones.

steps.title: Genomic DNA input from candidate clones
steps.text: Extract and purify genomic DNA from controls and candidate clones using the reusable gDNA module.

steps.title: PCR screening of the target locus
steps.text: Assemble locus PCR reactions, run thermal cycling, load gel lanes, and collect band readouts.

steps.title: Initial PCR readout
steps.text: Record predefined benchmark PCR-band outputs for controls and candidate clones.

steps.title: Genotype readout and clone classification
steps.text: Classify candidate clones using structured genotype readout and route heterozygous or unedited clones.

steps.title: Protein-level validation of genotype-qualified clone
steps.text: Acquire protein-level flow-cytometry evidence for genotype-qualified Clone A.

steps.title: Functional validation of protein-negative clone
steps.text: Run functional stimulation readout and route Clone A into the validated knockout output when controls pass.

steps.title: Record final clone status
steps.text: Record the final classifications of the candidate clones and return the validated knockout material.
